title: Kapinawá language
description: Extinct unattested language of eastern Brazil
extract: The Kapinawá language is a presumed and unattested language of northeastern Brazil, formerly spoken by the Kapinawá, who are now monolingual in Portuguese. As Kapinawá is unattested, it cannot be shown to have been distinct from neighboring languages. The Kapinawá are said to be descended from the Paratió, who spoke the Paratió language.
